num_x, num_y, max_n = map(int, input().split())

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def lcm(a, b):
    return a * b // gcd(a, b)

if num_y <= max_n:
    g = gcd(num_x, num_y)
    while g > 1:
        num_x //= g
        num_y //= g
        g = gcd(num_x, num_y)
    print(f"{num_x}/{num_y}")
else:
    min_diff_value = 1e9
    final_num = 0
    final_den = 1
    for i in range(1, max_n + 1):
        l = lcm(i, num_y)
        w = num_x * (l // num_y)
        diff1 = abs(w - ((w // (l // i)) * (l // i))) / l
        if min_diff_value > diff1:
            min_diff_value = diff1
            final_num = w // (l // i)
            final_den = i
        numerator = w + (l // i) - 1
        denominator = l // i
        diff2 = abs(w - ((numerator // denominator) * denominator)) / l
        if min_diff_value > diff2:
            min_diff_value = diff2
            final_num = numerator // denominator
            final_den = i
    g = gcd(final_num, final_den)
    final_num //= g
    final_den //= g
    print(f"{final_num}/{final_den}")
